transcription: /miz ɑ̃ plas/ · French for “everything in its place”
heroText: The rule of a professional kitchen: everything is prepared before the shift, the fresh stuff is in sight, nothing is forgotten.
title: Sign in
slogan: Every batch in sight. Every dish on time.
expired: Your session has ended — please sign in again.

lead.register: A restaurant is a separate organization: its own products, stock and staff. You will be its manager.
lead.join: The restaurant manager sends the invite code. The invite sets your role.

account.restaurantHint: Staff will see it in the app header.
account.fillDemoCatalog: Fill the catalog with an example
account.fillDemoCatalogHint: 26 products with prices and suppliers, 17 dishes — edit or delete them later.

errors.displayName: Enter your name — colleagues will see it.
errors.loginTaken: This login is taken — choose another.
errors.code: The code has 8 characters, e.g. K7Q2-PXM4.
errors.codeNotFound: Code not found, already used or expired — ask the manager for a new one.

serverWaking: Connecting to the server… If it was asleep, this takes up to a minute — demo access will appear here.
serverUnavailable: The server is not responding. Refresh the page in a minute.
